proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost.minutes
proposed_widenings.justification: Magical Cunning requires 1 minute (esoteric rite) to activate. ClassFeatureActivationCost only has 'free' and 'bonus_action'. A timed variant is needed to model features whose activation cost is measured in minutes, not action economy.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can perform an esoteric rite for 1 minute.

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect.refill_spell_slots
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature's sole effect is to regain expended Pact Magic spell slots up to a capped fraction of the warlock's maximum. No existing ClassFeatureEffect variant (grant_extra_action, heal_hp) captures slot refill. The v4 'refund' procedure atom and 'spell_slot' resource atom exist but are not surfaced as a ClassFeatureEffect variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you regain expended Pact Magic spell slots but no more than a number equal to half your maximum (round up)

notes: The 'activation' class-feature family applies in principle — the unit has a use-count resource, a long-rest reset cadence, and a single one-shot effect. Two surface gaps block honest encoding: (1) the 1-minute activation cost has no variant in ClassFeatureActivationCost; (2) there is no ClassFeatureEffect variant for slot refill. Both map to existing v4 atoms (refund + spell_slot), so this is surface_widening not atom_widening. Secondary modeling note: the feature targets the Pact Magic pool specifically (short-rest-recharging warlock slots), which is a distinct pool from standard spell slots. A pool discriminator field on the new effect variant would be needed to represent this honestly.
